meta.name: Geek Girl
meta.description: Awkward teen Harriet has always wanted to fit in. Until she gets scouted by a top London model agent and learns that some people are meant to stand out.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Harriet's textile class have won a trip to London Fashion Week, but she and her best friend Nat face an outfit disaster before they even get there.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: With just days to set up the most crucial casting of the season, Wilbur searches for Harriet — who's more concerned about a video that’s gone viral.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Harriet makes a bold fashion choice for her meeting with Wilbur and gets posing tips from a pro — but her career may be over before it's even begun.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: The stakes are high for Wilbur as he hunts for Yuji's new model. Will Harriet and Nat have what it takes to walk for one of fashion's biggest names?

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Harriet and her dad arrive in Canada. The show's just hours away, but there's still time to hang out with Nick — and his jealous "girlfriend".

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Everyone wants to speak to Harriet at the party, which amps her anxiety up to 11. Meanwhile, Nick confronts Poppy, and Yuji makes a decision.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Harriet struggles with how to break the news to Nat. But when she gets back to school she learns that Nat — and everyone else — knows the whole story.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: After an unsuccessful detour, the Manners family head to the perfume shoot. Poppy makes an announcement on social media, and Harriet posts her own video.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: While Harriet tries to put her social slip-up behind her, chaos reigns at Infinity. Nick arrives at school as the students prepare for the talent show.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Harriet resolves to stay true to herself, no matter what. When Wilbur visits the Manners', they all hatch a plan to get Harriet back on the catwalk.
